Compute Global Crop Area Percentage Range

Source: R/functions.R
compute_crop_percentage_range.Rd

Scans every district and every catchment, across every year plus their per-region average, to find a stable color-scale range for a given crop. Used to fix the crop-specific distribution map's color scale so that switching between years, districts, and catchments doesn't shift what a given color means, keeping visual comparisons across maps meaningful.

The upper bound is capped at the 95th percentile rather than the true max, since a single district/year with an unusually high share otherwise stretches the whole scale and collapses the typical range into one end of the palette. Values above the cap simply render as the darkest color (colorNumeric clamps out-of-domain values) instead of being distinguished from each other – an acceptable tradeoff for making the other ~95% of the map readable. If the 95th percentile collapses onto the minimum (e.g. a rare crop where most values are the same low number), the true max is used instead so the map doesn't go flat for everyone.

compute_crop_percentage_range(district_list, ezg_list, selected_crop)

Arguments

district_list

Named list of data frames/data.tables, one per district, each with a freq column and one or more Aggregated_YYYY/Name_YYYY crop columns. Pass NULL if district data is not available.

ezg_list

Named list with the same structure, one per catchment/basin. Pass NULL or NA if catchment data is not available.

selected_crop

Character string, the crop to compute percentages for

Value

Numeric vector of length 2: c(min_percentage, p95_percentage). Returns c(0, 1) if no data is available.
